verdict.rationale: Pendo's Leo answers natural-language questions about product data and lets users act on the answers by building guides and segments in the same conversation. Leo also monitors continuously and sends in-app alerts when metrics shift. Further in-product AI insights include Suggested Session Replays, automatic frustration-signal flagging, Pendo Predict churn prediction, and Agent Analytics grouping prompts into trends and roadmap needs. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Leo's insights and suggestions work (marketing pages only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
